about: People confirmed by eye on contact sheets and frames of the three indexed NBA videos (2026-10-12), and of two more videos indexed into a copy of that index (2026-10-13) to check that a name the owner gives carries over to new footage: a Rui Hachimura highlight reel shot by the wide game camera only (YouTube 9WE8t_yvcLM), and ESPN's last minute of Lakers at Raptors on 2025-12-04 (YouTube 1R1gb0oY2b8), where only Hachimura and LeBron James were labeled. Each label is one appearance: a face or body track. appearance_id is a hash of the track's video, kind, first time and box, so it survives regrouping; t (clearest frame, seconds) and box ([x, y, w, h] as frame shares at t) find the same track again if the video is re-indexed. Boxes holding two people were left out.

LeBron James.note: Lakers #23 at Philadelphia and against Golden State; a doctored 76ers #23 'JAMES' at Brooklyn

Draymond Green.note: Warriors white #23 'GREEN', the same number as LeBron

Jordan Goodwin.note: Lakers #30, the same number as Curry

Sideline reporter.note: blonde reporter at Golden State vs Lakers

76ers #25.note: a 76ers player whose name was not read

Fan in a #23 jersey.note: a fan in a gold Lakers #23 replica

Tyrese Maxey.note: 76ers #0; not found in the Philadelphia game

Kentavious Caldwell-Pope.note: 76ers #1 with a white headband, named by the lineup graphic

Nets #30.note: a Nets player whose name was not read

Man with light hair.note: the face wrongly grouped with LeBron

Referee #28.note: a referee wearing 28, in the Hachimura reel

Referee #39.note: a referee wearing 39, in the Hachimura reel

Referee #70.note: a referee wearing 70, in the Hachimura reel

Lakers #36.note: white Lakers #36, in the Hachimura reel

Grizzlies #23.note: a Memphis player in light blue #23, in the Hachimura reel
